summary_zh: 冰河湖遊船，約 40 分鐘，可現場買票，停車場是一天的費用，停在冰沙灘也要繳費，藍冰洞集合點也在這裡，旁邊是冰沙灘，步行 15 分可到，這裡有簡餐廳可以用餐。
summary_en: The glacier lagoon boat tour lasts about 40 minutes and tickets can be purchased on site. Parking costs a daily fee, and there is also a paid parking area on the ice beach. The blue ice cave meeting point is located here, next to the ice beach, which is a 15-minute walk away. A small restaurant nearby offers meals.
